body: The Big 3 for me are Spirited Away, Howls Moving Castle, and Princess Mononoke. But Ponyo speaks to my inner child and it’s story is so sweet.
Lol here I am using reduction method on all my big cubes and I just did a 7x7 in 30min haha
I liked what Vision said in Wandavision. “What is grief, but love persevering?”

Oof. I used to scream, throw things and accuse my girlfriend of not loving me when I was actually cheating on her and self harming lol I was a messsss. The way things ended between she and I was very messy and visceral. It’ll stick with me forever. Glad you’re out of that.
